breaking_news_suggestions.headline: Section 1.8 gains new kill-shot: dome's sun altitude swings 83% by season
breaking_news_suggestions.summary: EXP-580 restores the seasonal-altitude indeterminacy cascade (1,975–3,618 km) to Section 1.8. The dome's refraction fix forces the physical sun's altitude to vary 83% between solstices, but n(r) has no time-dependence — the medium cannot supply seasonally-varying refraction. A fixed minimum altitude (1,975 km) requires factor-of-three refractive lift inconsistent with Gaia astrometry. Cross-refs to WIN-046, WIN-056, WIN-044, WIN-002/-029.
breaking_news_suggestions.why_newsworthy: Restores load-bearing quantitative argument to Section 1.8 with explicit numerical cascade — the 83% swing figure and two-step squeeze are new explicitly-stated results, not just a prose restoration.
